name: The Penitent

source.note: A side quest boss of our own (The Frozen Pilgrims, docs/story/side_quests.md), built from the 2025 Monster Manual's frost giant: two great blows with reach, scaled to a CR 11 undead of fused, frozen pilgrims with a freezing embrace, legendary actions and Legendary Resistance. Drawn with the amber golem's sprite at Huge.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
traits.summary: Twice a day, a failed saving throw becomes a success.
traits.text: When the Penitent fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead, twice a day.

traits.name: The Bargain
traits.summary: Nine pilgrims asked the amber never to be cold again, and became the cold. It wants to be warm, and you are.
traits.text: The Penitent is what a vestige of the Amber Temple made of nine pilgrims who asked never to be cold again: their bodies, fused in ice around the one who led them. It goes for whatever is warmest.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The Penitent makes two Frozen Fist attacks.

actions.name: Frozen Fist
actions.summary: A fist of fused hands and ice, reach 10 ft.
actions.text: Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) Bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) Cold damage.

actions.name: Winter's Embrace
actions.summary: Recharge 5-6: everything within 20 ft makes a DC 16 Con save: 4d8 Cold and Restrained (frozen to the ground) until the end of its next turn, half damage on a success.
actions.text: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16, each creature within 20 feet of the Penitent. Failure: 18 (4d8) Cold damage, and the target has the Restrained condition until the end of the Penitent's next turn. Success: Half damage only.

options.name: Grinding Step
options.summary: Moves up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

summary: Nine frozen pilgrims fused into one kneeling giant of ice around the woman who led them, with a lamp still burning somewhere inside it. Its fists reach, its embrace freezes you where you stand, and it wants, more than anything, to be warm.
